metadata.description: Professional Chrome automation for Claude Code on macOS via stable AppleScript IDs + Chrome Local State profile catalog

plugins.name: claude-mac-chrome
plugins.description: Deterministic multi-profile Chrome automation on macOS. Reads Chrome's authoritative Local State profile catalog, extracts signed-in account emails from tab titles, and addresses windows/tabs via stable AppleScript string IDs. Zero user configuration, zero CDP, zero hardcoded URLs.
